name: debugsettings

schema.title: JSON schema for the ASP.NET DebugSettings.json files.

description:
The **LocalDebug** profile is set up to run the application directly from the executable located at */usr/local/bin/myapp*. It starts with the `--verbose` command‑line argument and uses */home/user/project* as the working directory. When launched, it automatically opens a browser pointing to **http://localhost:5000/home**. The environment for this profile defines `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT` as **Development** and provides a connection string under `ConnectionStrings__Default` set to `Server=localhost;Database=dev;`. This configuration targets SDK version **7.0.100**.

The **DockerDebug** profile, on the other hand, invokes the `dotnet` command with the arguments `run --project MyApp.csproj`. Its working directory is */app*, and it does **not** launch a browser automatically. The launch URL associated with this profile is **http://localhost:5000**, and the sole environment variable specified is `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT` set to **Staging**. Like the local profile, it also targets SDK version **7.0.100**.
